app.name: Sports VidIA
app.notConfiguredBody: Create a .env file from .env.example with your Supabase project URL and key, then restart the app.

common.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this? This cannot be undone.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.checkEmail: We sent you an email to confirm your account. Open the link and come back here.

club.noClubs: You are not a member of any club yet. Create one, or ask your club administrator to invite you with this email.
club.name: Club name
club.deleteClub: Delete the club and all its data
club.deleteClubConfirm: Type the club name to confirm:

home.phaseNote: You can now create matches, keep the score and code every game action (serve, reception, set, attack, block, dig and free ball) with its rating, zones and trajectory. Video and statistics arrive in the next phases.

members.title: Club users
members.inviteHelp: The person must sign up with this email; they will be added to the club automatically when they sign in.
members.lastAdmin: You can't remove the club's only administrator.

teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Name
teams.genericHelp: Creates placeholder players with consecutive numbers, handy for opponents: Name1 Surname1 (number 1), Name2 Surname2 (number 2)… You can edit them later.

players.title: Players
players.imageConsentHelp: Required to upload videos showing this player to YouTube. For minors, consent must come from their legal guardians.
players.privacyNote: For data protection only what statistics need is stored: no date of birth, contact details or photos.
players.numberTaken: That number is already taken in this team.

matches.title: Matches
matches.empty: No matches yet. Create one to get started.
matches.sameTeam: Home and away teams must be different.
matches.needTeams: You need at least two teams (yours and an opponent). Create them under Teams.
matches.noRoster: This team has no roster. Add players from the team's page.
matches.rosterLocked: The match has started: numbers and liberos can no longer change, but you can still add players.
matches.noPlayersCalled: No players selected for this team.
matches.takeOverHelp: As an administrator, you become the coder for this match.
matches.needRoster: Before starting, check both teams’ match rosters.

live.liberoAutoOut: {{team}}: libero {{libero}} leaves and {{player}} returns (moving to the front row).

cmdHelp.error: home / away error (point to the other team)

live.noCandidates: No legal substitution is possible for this player.
live.noLiberoOptions: No libero replacement is possible right now.
live.liberoRules: The libero may only replace back-row players, cannot serve, and must be replaced by the player they replaced. They leave automatically when they would rotate to the front row.
live.lineupIncomplete: Fill in all six positions for each team.
live.lineupHelp: Enter who plays in each position at the start of set {{set}}, as on the score sheet.
live.tiebreakToss: In the deciding set, first serve is decided by a toss.
live.autoLiberoMiddles: Comes in when a middle has just served (middles: {{list}}).
live.autoLiberoNoMiddles: No selected player is a Middle blocker: set it in the roster.
live.rotateForwardHelp: Rotate the line-up as on a side-out (II→I)

engine.set_in_play: The set is still in play.
engine.duplicate_player: A number appears twice in the line-up.
engine.libero_in_lineup: The libero cannot be in the starting line-up.

engine.max_timeouts: All {{max}} time-outs for this set have been used.

S.ok: OK: opponent cannot run a quick

legend.title: Code legend
legend.partTeam: Team: * home, a away (optional; see below how it is inferred)
legend.partPlayer: Shirt number (1 or 2 digits; may be omitted for serves)
legend.defaults: Several codes can be typed in a row separated by spaces, upper or lower case. If the team is omitted: the serve belongs to the serving team; the reception to the receiving team; after a serve or an attack (other than /), the action belongs to the other team; otherwise, to the team of the last action.
legend.autoPoint: These actions end the rally and add the point automatically.
legend.zonesHelp: Each half court is numbered from the point of view of the team playing on it. Turn on “Mark zones” to tap start and end on the court.
legend.ex1: positive serve by the player in position I
legend.ex3: set by 3 and winning quick attack by away 11, from zone 3 to 8
legend.ex4: serve error by home 12 (point for away)
legend.ex5: full rally: the block by away 2 wins the point
legend.doubleSigns: You can also type ++ instead of # and -- instead of = (they are saved as # and =).

code.pickPlayer: Tap a player on court (or choose Serve)
code.tapStart: Tap the start on the court

csv.helpAll: Each row is a player. The “team” column says which team they belong to; missing teams are created. You can use Excel and save as “CSV UTF-8”.
csv.helpTeam: Each row is a player of {{team}}. You can use Excel and save as “CSV UTF-8”.
csv.needTeamColumn: The file has no “team” column. To import it, open a team’s page and import the players there.
csv.newTeamsOwn: New teams belong to the club (otherwise they are created as opponents)
csv.updateRule: If a number already exists in the team, that player’s details are updated.
csv.result: Done: {{teams}} new teams, {{created}} new players and {{updated}} updated.

video.title: Video
video.help: With the video loaded, every action you code stores the video time. Local files are not uploaded: each device picks the file from its own disk.
video.badUrl: The YouTube link was not recognised.

err.youtube_api: Could not load the YouTube player. Check your connection.
err.file: This browser cannot play the file. Try an MP4 (H.264).

video.syncHelp: If you coded the match without video (e.g. live), move the video to the exact moment of one of the actions (it is now at {{time}}) and choose it from the list. The other actions are placed according to the time they were coded.
video.syncOnlyMissing: Only actions that have no time yet
video.goTo: Show this play in the video
video.setTime: Set the current video time on this action
video.autoPause: Pause the video while typing codes

clips.title: Filtered video
clips.none: No action with a video time matches the filters.
clips.needVideo: Load the match video to watch these plays.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.empty: No actions have been coded in this match yet.
stats.pointsHelp: Points: aces + attack kills + block points
stats.errorsHelp: Errors giving a point to the opponent (=, blocked attack, block fault)
stats.showClips: Show these plays in the video
stats.clickHelp: Click a number to watch the matching plays in the video.
stats.rotationHelp: P1–P6: setter position at the start of the rally. If no player has the Setter position, the player in position I is shown.
stats.zoneHelp_one: {{count}} action with a zone. Seen from the team playing in each half, net at the top.
stats.zoneHelp_other: {{count}} actions with a zone. Seen from the team playing in each half, net at the top.
stats.noOwnTeams: There are no club teams. Create one under Teams.
stats.noMatches: This team has no played matches with data yet.
